TEXT:
[FI] I was looking up at a dazzling blue sky while 
waiting at the designated place.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] This is what they'd call the perfect weather for a 
date, I guess...

[FI] I unintentionally murmured as I stood there feeling 
pretty good.

[FI] Why? It's time for our date. And it has nothing to 
do with stuff like otakus and Akiba?!
[FI] It's as if this blue sky has given me its blessing...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I'm sorry to keep you waiting, Onii-san.

[FI] Tired of waiting, I turned to face that voice, and 
there was my beloved angel.

[FI] Due to her divine appearance, people passing by 
couldn't help but turn their heads and stare in awe.

[FI] Well, that's a given. With someone as cute as her, 
even I would turn to catch a glimpse.

[FI] To think someone like that is my girlfriend... My life is 
complete!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I haven't been waiting that long.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Good... Actually, aren't you a little too early?

[FI] Ayase looked up at me with a slightly troubled 
smile.

[FI] She held quite a big basket in her hands, but... 
what's inside...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Yes. It's still ten minutes before the appointed time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I just wanted to see you as soon as possible.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Geez, Onii-san, you always say things like that.

[FI] After looking a bit embarrassed, her face red, 
Ayase naturally took my hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Shall we go then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

[FI] Ayase is in charge of our date today. Apparently, 
there was a place she wanted to go with me.

[FI] Well, I personally don't know this part of town well, 
so I have no choice but to quietly tag along.

[FI] With Ayase pulling at my hand, we started walking 
through the Odaiba district.

[FI] However, as expected from Odaiba, there are a lot 
of couples here. A lot of them walk around hand in 
hand as well...

[FI] Still, just to make things clear, Ayase-tan is still the 
cutest of them all!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] What is it? You're just smiling away.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I was just thinking how lucky I am to be dating 
someone as cute as you, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] G-Geez, you can't just blurt out something like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I seriously--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Onii-san, you're so insincere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]What?![/font_size]

[FI] But I was just being honest that Ayase is the 
cutest in the world...
[FI] Maybe I'm getting ahead of myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Onii-san, you're pretty cool too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] You're really cool, Onii-san. More than anyone else.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh.

[FI] I was left speechless by Ayase's unexpected 
counterattack.

[FI] She might've just been doing her part as my 
girlfriend, but Ayase saying that makes me 
extremely happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Well then, let's go look at clothes first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] L-Lead the way.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm going to show you around a lot of places, so 
you'd better be prepared.

[FI] Seeing Ayase smiling at me, I almost thought I'd 
died and ended up in heaven.
[FI] Truly a frightening girl, you are...

[FI] As we entered the shopping mall, Ayase went 
straight into one of the shops. Seems like she comes 
here often.
[FI] Well, I don't really mind, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This place really isn't for me, huh.

[FI] The clothes lined up were, of course, for women. 
Frankly, if not for Ayase, people would probably be 
suspicious of me going in here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] This store is quite famous, and I often wear their 
clothes in my work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Really...
[FI] So, I guess Kirino's also been here before?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, aren't these clothes cute?

[FI] As I was looking around the shop restlessly, Ayase 
had found some interesting clothes and rushed off 
towards a nearby shelf.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san~! Over here~!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] What do you think of this? Or maybe this one...

[FI] Ayase looked jubilant as she held up the clothes in 
front of her. And yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] T-They're fine, I guess?
[FI] That was all I could say, really.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] That's not it, Onii-san, what I'm asking is which of 
these do you want to see me in?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I wouldn't mind either one.

[FI] Ayase would look cute in both anyway. Eh, wait, am 
I being tested?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] T-That's not quite it either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, just think about it seriously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-Well... This one?
[FI] I pointed at the clothes in Ayase's left hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see. Wait here for a bit, okay?
[FI] Ayase said that and left for a nearby dressing room.
[FI] After a short time...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] How does it look? Does it suit me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]Amazingly cute![/font_size]

[FI] I replied to Ayase with all my energy as she came 
out of the dressing room.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, then I'm getting this one.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright, I'll buy it for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I think it looks good on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onii-san... Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Then I'll wear this for the rest of our date today.

[FI] As she said that, Ayase once again entered the 
dressing room.
[FI] ...No need to stand around here waiting.
[FI] Guess I'll go and pay the bill while she's changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh? The bill...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I took care of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I'm sorry. It wasn't too expensive, was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't worry about it.

[FI] Honestly, it did hurt my wallet quite a bit. But well, 
this is also the boyfriend's responsibility, I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Thank you so very much. Shall we be off then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? You don't want any other clothes?
[FI] She had seemed pretty troubled about it earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] It's fine. After all, Onii-san, my goal was to have you 
tell me I looked cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ayase...

[FI] What's with this girl? Is she going to sprout wings 
from her back now? Is she really an angel?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe~

[FI] Ayase innocently clinging to my arm, I'm honestly 
starting to feel a bit dizzy.

[FI] The next place we arrived at was a cafe, which in 
my eyes seemed like quite a classy place.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I've been curious about this cafe for a while now.

[FI] Ayase explained as she guided me towards our 
seats.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I read about it in a magazine and thought that I'd 
want to come here someday with you, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm honored.

[FI] I'm somehow managing to reply calmly, but on the 
inside, I'm so happy I feel I might burst out 
dancing any moment now.

[FI] I mean, she said she wanted to come here with me, 
you know? I can hardly believe I'm actually dating 
Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It seems this cafe is famous for their cheesecake.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then I think I'll have that as well.

[FI] I unintentionally narrowed my eyes as I watched 
Ayase's lively face, engrossed in the menu.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, we'll be having lunch after this, so you shouldn't 
eat too much, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I know that.

[FI] Looks like I'll be enjoying this day with Ayase to the 
fullest.
